attributes.name: AMI Ingest JSON Template
attributes.twig:
{
{#- Updated for 1.6.0 to handle DOI events from CSV 
- Requires DataCite subscription and most importantly the Fragaria module to be enabled
which is the one that provides the sbf_datacite twig extension doing all validation
For an AMI set, a CSV column "doi_datacite_action" can contain one of: draft, register, publish or delete
doi_event and dataOriginal (original data of an ADO being updated,
only present if this template is used to update existing ones) is
passed to the `sbf_datacite` twig extension, wich will return only an entry for the active API
if all is valid based on previously known state #}
{# Data Cite Setup: If all previos conditions apply, please remove lines 12 and 25 #}
{% set ap_tasks = null %}
{#-
{%- if datacite_enabled %}
  {% set doi_event = data.doi_datacite_action|default(null) %} 
  {% set doi_ap_tasks = sbf_datacite(dataOriginal|default([]), doi_event) %}
  {% set ap_tasks = doi_ap_tasks["ap:tasks"]|default([]) %}
  {% if dataOriginal["ap:tasks"] is defined and dataOriginal["ap:tasks"] is not empty %}
    {% if dataOriginal["ap:tasks"]["ap:fragaria"] is defined and ap_tasks["ap:fragaria"] is defined %}
       {% set ap_fragaria = dataOriginal["ap:tasks"]["ap:fragaria"]|merge(ap_tasks["ap:fragaria"]) %}
       {% set ap_tasks = {"ap:fragaria": ap_fragaria } %}
    {% endif %}
	{% set ap_tasks = dataOriginal["ap:tasks"]|merge(ap_tasks) %} 
  {% endif %}
{% endif -%}
-#}
{# ap_tasks is used at the end of this template #}
